note: Offline sample: a real but partial subset of confirmed planets (hosts within 25 pc plus a few notable systems).
query: select pl_name,hostname,pl_letter,ra,dec,sy_dist,sy_disterr1,sy_disterr2,sy_plx,sy_plxerr1,sy_plxerr2,sy_snum,sy_pnum,st_spectype,st_teff,st_mass,st_rad,sy_vmag,gaia_dr3_id,hd_name,hip_name,pl_orbper,pl_orbsmax,pl_rade,pl_bmasse,pl_orbeccen,pl_eqt,disc_year,discoverymethod,disc_facility from pscomppars where sy_dist < 25 or hostname in ('Kepler-90','Kepler-452','Kepler-186','TRAPPIST-1','KELT-9','HR 8799','51 Peg','WASP-12','OGLE-2005-BLG-390L')

rows.disc_facility: University of Canterbury Mt John Observatory
